title: Nithin Jambula
description: Robotics software, agentic AI, architecture & infrastructure

items.title: Site rebuilt as plain HTML
items.content_text: The portfolio is now plain HTML and CSS: pixel-art avatar, Atom/RSS/JSON feeds, CITATION.cff, vCard, topics index.

items.title: 16fps: multi-agent text-to-video, commercial rights sold
items.content_text: A multi-agent system that generates consistent 60+ second videos from text using memory, tool use and reflection. Commercial rights and operational access sold to a media production company.

items.title: DeepShield published at iSAI 2025
items.content_text: Face-swap deepfake detection: +22% accuracy, 18% fewer false positives, GAN-based data augmentation. Published at the 20th International Conference, iSAI 2025.

items.title: Joined Ananta Technologies as Robotics Software Intern
items.content_text: MuJoCo and Webots simulation testing for a US client; build tests ~40% faster; two robots deployed.

items.title: EchoSight named awardee at Vikas 2024; patent filed
items.content_text: Assistive navigation glasses running YOLOv8 at 45+ FPS on a Raspberry Pi, with spatial voice feedback.

items.title: Student researcher at AIR Centre, VIT-AP
items.content_text: NeuroSecAPI: neuro-symbolic, LLM-driven API vulnerability detection. +34% vulnerabilities found vs SAST/DAST, 70% less manual testing.

items.title: Vulcan self-driving EV: perception & navigation lead
items.content_text: DeepLabV3+ segmentation, lane following, CARLA + SAC + DAgger, real-time on NVIDIA Jetson.
